divergences.reason: `FilesPage.swift:70` is the cancel key of the `3D 示例` demo sheet (`sheet-62`), a preview host page that this App does not have: `onOpenDemo` has no host implementation, so the sheet never presents and its cancel key has no Android counterpart. Implementing the demo sheet needs a page-surface host, tracked separately.
